proof_obligations.PO-FAMILY: Use growing vector dimensions/moduli, not a fixed q=4 benchmark as the claimed breakthrough.
proof_obligations.PO-INPUT-MODEL: Preserve unknown sample-only access and account for each quantum register exactly once.
proof_obligations.PO-CLASSICAL-BASELINE: Compare end-to-end sample/gate/space cost with named sieves and legal public-code attacks.
proof_obligations.PO-REDUCTION: Give a natural-problem parameter map, including the number and approximation quality of supplied states; no automatic standard-LWE claim.
proof_obligations.PO-MECHANISM: Construct an outcome-adaptive high-throughput transformation or a non-product decoder. Fixed-direction all-outcome native m=3n extraction is closed by a local conductor/distance derivation, not by a general quantum no-go.
proof_obligations.PO-STATE-PREP: The first parity chart is provided. Higher charts, alignment, unknown state copies and inverses are not free.
proof_obligations.PO-NATURAL-ACCESS: Prove selection lineage and posterior source law. At q=8 low-bit-only extraction has native acceptance 2^(-n dim E) when consistent and joint output entropy n(2d-dim(U intersect E)) conditional on B and the selected basis; conditional fresh IID labels require zero intersection. Mixtures over different low labels/bases are not classified here. General low-defined overlapping menus pay the stated (q/4)^n source penalty, with menu/attempt factors. Arbitrary higher-bit or outcome-adaptive synthesis requires a new theorem.
proof_obligations.PO-MEASUREMENT: Return independent verified secret equations or a complete decoder; do not count retained entangled qubits as output equations. Joint Bell likelihoods are not products of parity marginals. A parity selector must precede v or account for the full selection law. Charge chosen XOR outcomes and all source attempts. The local tail-unit one-bit transcript bound does not cover full v or quantum memory.
proof_obligations.PO-SUCCESS-PROOF: Prove source coverage, equation rank and bounded-error full-secret recovery, including the actual contamination promise. The first parity chart loses the highest original secret bit per coordinate; distinguish packet residue from full original secret. Uncorrected real Bell readout is invariant under residue negation. Proposed residue verification requires fresh independent higher-label packets and a candidate committed before their labels; full-candidate verification and lost-bit completion require fresh original phase states. None of these ideal certificates proves noisy completeness or discovers a candidate.
proof_obligations.PO-COMPLEXITY: Polynomial construction in n and log q, precision and storage, with product loss and original-state consumption composed through every level of the actual target. The t=Theta(log n) benchmark is not the natural lattice coordinate regime t=Theta(n).
proof_obligations.PO-NOISE-LINEAGE: Prove the ACTUAL natural-reduction noise promise through every chart and source selection. Independent original Z errors produce correlated K-transpose logical masks; arbitrary Regev basis failures are not IID phase flips and can bias chart outcomes. Source averaging needs explicit higher-label/secret independence. Marginal error rates do not establish independence or conditional-history budgets. Constant-noise uniformization does not close vanishing-noise or other-measurement protocols.
proof_obligations.PO-NOISY-COMPLETION: Known-residue classicalization requires correct lower residue and fresh ORIGINAL states. Phase-only errors yield commuting classical samples, not a coherent quantum-example oracle or generic polynomial LPN decoder. Low-noise clean-block baselines require the native label rank law. Public-bias filtering requires public constant contamination and a known bad basis bit, with failures charged; it is not lossless one-copy equivalence. Full-candidate robust verification requires a candidate committed before fresh labels and bad-probability bounds for each fixed secret/history. Account for correction/filter gate precision. No verifier discovers the unknown residue.
proof_obligations.PO-PRELABEL-GAUGE: The existing X/sign gauge legally transfers prelabel classical mixtures of good/basis registers to a fault-avoidance phase channel only when uniform Fourier labels are independent of fault data and old labels/coins are discarded before selection. IID basis failures then have phase-flip rate gamma/2; correlations do not become IID. Exact sparse-law source moments use conceptual independent draws of the entire joint fault law, not extra physical copies. The two-point q=2M coordinate-QFT map supplies conditional gamma=(n log2 q)^(-f) completion accounting, not a verified natural-lattice M/state-supply/precision map. Do not introduce a constant-rate LPN blocker from this vanishing-noise promise.
proof_obligations.PO-CONSUMED-PHASE-PROGRAMS: Each unknown program is consumed once; random signed labels, all branches, public Boolean compute/uncompute and fresh target/workspace are charged. A pullback does not supply an inverse of the random phase map, repeated queries, doubled-label resources or packet clones. Low-label-only selectors preserve conditional native higher labels. Full sign-orbit selectors also have a valid updated source, but its conditional columns are uniform sign-orbit elements, not uniform higher bits; derive new moments instead of importing fixed-low-chart averaging. Other high-label selectors are legal circuits needing their joint pushforward law. For fixed functions across all higher tables at q>=8, source-universal phase products require single literals/constants; nonlinear or multi-variable parity functions do not guarantee independent output equations. Nonproduct or higher-selected inference remains open.
proof_obligations.PO-NOGO: Respect the direct-Hadamard conductor gate and the q>=8 fixed-direction all-complement-outcome throughput cap, including its uniform pure-product trace-error extension below sin(pi/8). Outcome-adaptive extraction, average-error protocols, correlated decoding and general measurements remain open. The source-orthogonal SQ bound covers bounded single-record expectation queries at the declared tolerance, not raw-sample or multi-record learning. Logical-output-noise uniformization covers the fixed fresh-pair protocol, not detector repetition, native correlated phase errors, label-adaptive matching or arbitrary quantum measurements.
proof_obligations.PO-DEQUANTIZATION: Known-secret stabilizer simulation and per-trial likelihood scoring are calibration, not unknown-secret classical decoders. Test legal baselines on identical sources. Existing same-state stabilizer/polynomial phase learners require a copy source or source-preserving alignment theorem; varying native packets do not grant either. Fixed q=4/8 likelihood mechanisms require growing-modulus extension before any breakthrough claim.
proof_obligations.PO-FALSIFIERS: Preregister the maximal-yield/source-law tests below and retain negative outcomes without candidate promotion. Full-output collision is not mutual information or identification success, and a high source mean is not typical-instance evidence. Charge the exponential rank-sum mask enumeration and do not extrapolate it into an efficient decoder. Source-centered orbit orthogonality gives positive L2 separation only when its diagonal norm is nonzero; effective-order-two residues can have additional uniform-law aliases on fixed charts. Do not interpret SQ or noise-model failure as general hardness.
